 United Airlines experiencing a widespread system outage, airline says
 By Danya Gainor , Pete Muntean 
 Updated Nov 16, 2026, 5:27 PM ET 
 PUBLISHED Nov 16, 2026, 5:12 PM ET 
 United Airlines passenger planes are seen at gates at Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) in Newark, New Jersey, on November 15, 2026. 
 Charly Triballeau/AFP/Getty Images

 United Airlines is experiencing a widespread system outage affecting departing flights and is working to get operations “back up and running as soon as possible,” the airline said in a post on X , just days after a rare FAA ground stop halted all departures nationwide for hours .
 The Federal Aviation Administration is aware of the incident, agency spokesperson Hannah Walden told CNN. The FAA referred questions back to United Airlines.
 There is no impact on flights in progress or on United Express flights, United Airlines said.
 The aviation agency had largely returned to normal operations after the ground stop was lifted just after 8 p.m. ET on Friday, though airlines have still worked to reposition planes, crews and luggage as they grappled with the weekend’s score of cancellations and delays .
 This is a developing story and will be updated. 
 CNN’s Alexandra Skores contributed to this report.
